title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for CKD.

HPI
The patient is a 64-year-old male presenting today for a scheduled follow-up regarding his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling generally stable but notes occasional fatigue and mild swelling in his lower extremities at the end of the day. He denies any acute shortness of breath, chest pain, or sudden weight gain. He is compliant with his current medication regimen and reports no significant side effects.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily, Furosemide 40mg daily.

Exam
The patient appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Physical examination reveals clear lung sounds and no peripheral edema. Skin is intact with no signs of uremic frost. Heart rate and blood pressure are within normal limits.

Assessment
Chronic kidney disease, stage 5. The patient is currently stable on his maintenance medications.

Plan
Continue current medication dosages. Laboratory work will be ordered to monitor potassium and creatinine levels. The patient will return to the clinic in three months for a repeat evaluation of his CKD.
explanations: CKD stage 5 (not documented as ESRD): N18.5.
